Marcus — technical note on the decision we need for the exec readout: I ran perf sims on the 8k context model with the two quantization profiles. Summary attached (perf_estimates.csv):
- Profile A (low-latency): slightly larger memory footprint, median p50 18ms token, cost +12%
- Profile B (high-quant): smaller footprint, median p50 28ms token, cost -22%

If execs prioritize latency for customer demo days, we should present Profile A and accept a higher per-token cost for the QBR window. If cost reduction is the priority for the pilot, present Profile B and offer a staged latency optimization plan. Need product direction by COB 12/10 so we can lock the staging tests Jonas mentioned.

Karthik
